title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E10 — O 'Oe, a 'Owau, Nalo Ia Mea
When Adam's girlfriend is kidnapped right in front of him, he shuts out Five-0 and breaks all the rules in order to get her back; the team investigates three seemingly unconnected homicides.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E11 — Ka I Ka 'Ino, No Ka 'Ino
A tourist helicopter is shot down by a missile; a search for stolen artillery leads to a ghost from McGarrett's past -- Wo Fat; Adam makes a bold decision about his future with Five-0.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E10 — Matty + Ethan + Fidelity
Matty reveals the shocking secret that her husband has been undercover in a criminal organization for eight years; when his status as a CIA agent comes out, Matty needs MacGyver to find and extract her husband before it's too late.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E11 — Mac + Fallout + Jack
Mac and Jack's mini-vacation is cut short when someone from their past abducts them and locks them in a concrete room; Matty tasks Riley, Bozer and Leanna with stealing a diamond encoded with terrorist intelligence from a princess in Milan.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E12 — Fence + Suitcase + Americium-241
Mac and the gang team up with a master thief to catch an underworld criminal who hired her to steal a dirty bomb.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E13 — Wilderness + Training + Survival
When MacGyver takes Riley and Bozer into the wilderness for survival training, things take a turn when they run into a violent group of criminals; Jack and Matty go on a road trip to place Matty's ex-husband and his family in witness protection.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E14 — Father + Bride + Betrayal
An international crime boss offers to surrender if he's allowed to return to the United States to watch his daughter walk down the aisle; MacGyver and the team crash the wedding to ensure the crime lord doesn't run.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E15 — K9 + Smugglers + New Recruit
After a surprising introduction to Phoenix's newest recruit, Desi, MacGyver and team are assigned to protect a gun-sniffing dog who has a bounty on its head.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E16 — Lidar + Rogues + Duty
The Phoenix must recover the body of a pilot whose plane crashed while testing an experimental laser mapping system that MacGyver designed; Riley tries to identify the hacker who tricked a SWAT team into arresting her and Elwood.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E17 — Seeds + Permafrost + Feather
MacGyver and the team are asked to solve a locked-door mystery when a man working inside a remote, ultra-secure international seed vault disappears.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E22 — Profiling 101
The team leads a class of college students through the nearly 20-year chase for a serial killer.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E23 — Hit
When the BAU is called to negotiate a situation at a federal bank, one of their own becomes a hostage; Prentiss says goodbye.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E24 — Run
When the BAU is called to negotiate a situation at a federal bank, one of their own becomes a hostage; Prentiss says goodbye.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E01 — The Silencer
The BAU investigates when a prisoner escapes and starts leaving behind victims with his unique trademark; the team gets to know its newest member.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E02 — The Pact
When a murder victim is discovered in San Diego and another is found in Los Angeles, the team thinks a murderous duo is responsible.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E03 — Through the Looking Glass
When one Kansas family goes missing and another one turns up dead, the team looks for a link between the cases; Beth has surprising news for Hotch.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E04 — God Complex
The BAU team pursues an amateur surgeon who amputates limbs from his victims; Reid's calls to a mystery woman create intrigue.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

When four men from Oregon go missing, the team looks for a common link; J.J. is upset when her son doesn't want to celebrate Halloween.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E06 — The Apprenticeship
The team searches for a killer in Miami who started out slaying animals and then quickly progressed to murdering prostitutes; Morgan asks Reid to join the bureau softball team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E07 — The Fallen
The team travels to Santa Monica when burned bodies start showing up on a pier; Rossi gets together with his former Marine sergeant from Vietnam.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E08 — The Wheels on the Bus ...
The BAU team springs into action when a school bus full of children goes missing near Washington, D.C.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E09 — Magnificent Light
A popular motivational speaker comes under suspicion when a conference attendee is murdered; Garcia is confused when Morgan doesn't want to attend a dinner honoring a family friend.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E10 — The Lesson
When multiple dead men are found, the BAU tracks a killer with ritualistic tendencies; Reid is anxious when faced with an opportunity to meet his mystery woman.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E11 — Perennials
The team tracks a suspect who shares the same style as a serial killer from 30 years ago; someone tracks the BAU's cases and replicates crimes.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E12 — Zugzwang
With the help of the BAU team, Reid tries to find his girlfriend before it's too late.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E13 — Magnum Opus
As Reid deals with a personal loss, the rest of the team heads to San Francisco after victims are found in the Mission District.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E05 — Buckle Up
Toby goes undercover to find a group of thieves posing as police officers.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E06 — Witness for the Prosecution
Toby and Michelle investigate a potential conspiracy linked to a mob murder trial.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E07 — Caged In
After witnessing the death of an MMA fighter, Toby looks into the business dealings of two rival leagues.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E08 — The Illustrated Woman
Toby's investigation into the murder of a tattooed woman leads him to believe that corporate espionage and blackmail are behind the killing.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E18 — The Other Shoe
Bull puts aside his personal grievances to help AUSA Reilly, who prosecuted him for jury tampering, bring one of the world's most dangerous drug lords to justice; the pair enter into a hesitant partnership.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E19 — Opening Up
When Bull is sidelined with a back injury, Marissa and Chunk are forced to go to court without him to defend Marissa's closest childhood friend, Kyla, a tech CEO accused of wrongfully terminating an employee.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E20 — The Envelope, Please
Bull breaks from the stress he's been under for months when a mysterious delivery causes him to black out for hours, leaving him with no memory of his movements.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E21 — Silent Killer
When Bull handles the defense of a building owner accused of killing tenants by carbon monoxide poisoning, the case rocks Bull and the team to their core.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E22 — Goodbye
Bull and the team head to court one last time to finalize a negligent homicide defense that will change the nature of their company and their lives forever.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E01 — The Necklace
Dr. Jason Bull uses psychology, intuition and data to create strategies to help clients of his trial consulting firm win cases.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E02 — The Woman in 8D
Dr. Bull and his team must come up with a new defense for a female pilot accused of negligence when they discover the jury has a gender bias.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E03 — Unambiguous
Bull and the team tackle jury bias as their client publicly accuses a star athlete of assaulting her; Benny encounters an ex, who happens to be a fellow attorney.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E14 — The Doll in the Derby
When a female roller derby skater is killed and dismembered, Angie goes undercover to help solve the case; Cam tries to learn more about Booth's secretive hospital appointments.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E15 — The Shot in the Dark
While in the hospital after being shot at the lab, Brennan struggles with visions of her mother that defy her usual logic; evidence may link Brennan's attacker to the Jeffersonian.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E16 — The Friend in Need
As the team investigates the death of a seemingly innocent 15-year-old boy, they learn that he was involved in illegal activity.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E17 — The Fact in the Fiction
When a well-educated but eccentric intern starts working at the Jeffersonian, Brennan tries to be more open-minded about scientific questions.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E18 — The Survivor in the Soap
The team investigates the death of a young man whose remains were found at a hazardous waste disposal facility; Cam and Arastoo struggle to keep their relationship secret; Brennan and Booth try to decide where to take their vacation.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E19 — The Doom in the Gloom
The investigation into the death of a former Marine leads the team to a group obsessed with preparing for the apocalypse; Sweets finds an apartment.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E20 — The Blood From the Stones
The team investigates when an undercover cop turns up dead with a bag of diamonds inside his body; Brennan struggles to be likable as the subject of a documentary film.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E21 — The Maiden in the Mushrooms
The team investigates when a TV producer is murdered; Christine is accused of biting a classmate; Hodgins uses his tools at the Jeffersonian to chemically re-create Finn's hot sauce.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E22 — The Party in the Pants
The team investigates when a stockbroker -- who moonlights as a stripper -- is murdered; after a 24-year absence, Booth's mother (Joanna Cassidy) shows up with a request.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E23 — The Pathos in the Pathogens
The team tries to prevent a viral outbreak during an investigation into a journalist's murder, whose infected body is found at a biohazard facility; when Arastoo Vaziri is affected by the mutated virus, the only way to save him is to solve the case.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E24 — The Secret in the Siege
Christopher Pelant returns to toy with the Jeffersonian team; an investigation reveals a string of murders tied to FBI agents; Brennan evaluates her relationship with Booth.

title: Bones
description:
S09 E01 — The Secrets in the Proposal
The remains of an accountant for the state department are found in a hotel air conditioning unit; Booth finds an Army buddy and CIA agent, Danny Beck, removing evidence from the victim's condo; Brennan contemplates her future with Booth.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E13 — The Hurricane Job
Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E14 — The Great Train Job
When a hate group targets two farmers, the team digs deep into a corrupt green energy innovator and plans a traditional train heist.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E15 — The Muddy Waters Job
The team goes undercover on an oil rig to find dirt on a crooked CEO who is covering up oil spills.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E16 — The Harry Wilson Job
The team sneaks into R.I.Z. to stop them from destroying the electrical grid, but they need Harry's help.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E14 — Sick and Evil
The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E15 — Truth or Dare
Rossi prepares to marry Krystall; the team investigates a series of fatal shootings following car accidents.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E01 — Under the Skin
The BAU team investigates an unsub with striking similarities to Rossi's latest obsession, "The Chameleon."

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E02 — Awakenings
The team searches for Everett Lynch and his daughter; Spencer has a meaningful visit with his mother.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E03 — Spectator Slowing
The BAU team investigates a series of seemingly random fatal explosions throughout Kentucky and Tennessee.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E04 — Saturday
The members of the BAU enjoy a Saturday off in vastly different ways; Rossi and Prentiss help Simmons assemble a new crib; Garcia leads a hacking competition; Dr. Reid strikes up a conversation with a woman named Maxine.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E05 — Ghost
Following a series of fatal shootings, the BAU team travels to Illinois to investigate what appears to be a copycat serial killer.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E06 — Date Night
After a father and daughter get kidnapped, a former foe of the BAU returns with very specific demands for Dr. Reid.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E07 — Rusty
When the BAU team travels to Denver to investigate several murders, Prentiss is forced to evaluate her relationship with Special Agent Andrew Mendoza.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E08 — Family Tree
Prentiss and J.J. are faced with important decisions to make about their futures as the BAU travels to Texas to investigate a series of murdered businessmen.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E09 — Face Off
Rossi develops some new theories about Everett Lynch, aka The Chameleon; the team sets out on an epic hunt to capture Lynch.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E10 — And in the End
While hallucinating after he gets a brain injury, Dr. Reid is visited by ghosts from his past; the BAU makes a shocking discovery about Lynch that affects Rossi personally; the team comes together to celebrate Rossi's retirement.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E01 — The Longest Night
The team closes in on a serial killer (Tim Curry) holding Detective Spicer's daughter hostage.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E02 — JJ
JJ tries to reunite parents with their missing daughter; the team braces for the loss of one of its own.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E03 — Remembrance of Things Past
When several women are murdered, Rossi revisits a 25-year-old case that causes him to suspect a killer is at work again.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E04 — Compromising Positions
The team searches for a serial killer who is preying on married couples; Hotchner looks to a team member to fill JJ's vacant role.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E05 — Safe Haven
The team pursues a serial killer targeting families in the Midwest; Morgan receives a visit from Ellie after she runs away from her foster family.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E06 — Devil's Night
The team searches for a killer who has struck the past three years during Detroit's raucous pre-Halloween celebrations.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E07 — Middle Man
When bodies turn up in Indiana cornfields, the team must catch a pack of serial killers targeting exotic dancers.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E08 — Reflection of Desire
The team tries to stop a killer from striking again after the body of a kidnapped woman is found in an alley.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E18 — Murdoc + Helman + Hit
When Nicholas Helman resurfaces to carry out a killing spree, the team is forced to get help from the one person who knows him best -- his protégé, Murdoc.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E19 — Friends + Enemies + Border
MacGyver and Desi help a group of Syrian refugees who are being pursued by human traffickers; Bozer is trapped in Oversight's car, and it's rigged to explode.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E20 — No-Go + High-Voltage + Rescue
Two American tourists go missing while doing a scavenger hunt through some of the world's most dangerous countries; the Phoenix team goes undercover as backpackers to find them and bring them home alive.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E22 — Mason + Cable + Choices
A cunning new adversary's carefully crafted plans force Mac to make an impossible choice: save the life of a friend or save the lives of hundreds of innocents; Mac receives new information that will drive a wedge between him and his father.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E21 — Treason + Heartbreak + Gum
Matty's ex-husband, Ethan, asks her for help when a criminal organization kidnaps his wife and daughter; Matty must decide if she's willing to commit treason to help Ethan; Riley joins Billy Colton and Mama Colton on a mission to Paris.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E01 — Fire + Ashes + Legacy = Phoenix
Ex-MI6 agent Russ Taylor recruits former Phoenix Foundation members Mac, Riley, Bozer, Matty and Desi to hunt down a bioweapon that's planned to be used by a mysterious organization for a devastating attack on a major US city.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E02 — Red Cell + Quantum + Cold + Committed
Gen. John Acosta recruits MacGyver to steal a highly classified project from a military lab to find flaws in its security.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E03 — Kid + Plane + Cable + Truck
MacGyver and the team are on a plane that's in the air when the pilot has a heart attack.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E06 — The Crack in the Code
After a cryptic message written in human blood is found at a national monument, the team ends up embarking on a scavenger hunt; Brennan and Booth search for their perfect family home.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E07 — The Prisoner in the Pipe
When the remains of an escaped convict are found in the sewer, the investigation reveals the man died in prison; Brennan gives birth in unconventional circumstances.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E08 — The Bump in the Road
When an extreme couponer's remains are found on the side of a road, the investigation leads the team to the supermarket where she shopped; Brennan adjusts to being at work and away from her baby; Cam is unhappy with her daughter's choice of suitors.
